parole.significato: direction (indication of the point toward which an object is moving)
parole.testo: Uncertain, with no known cognates (other than descendants). It is not known whether a short -u- or long -uu- is primary. * Possibly borrowed from Baltic (compare Lithuanian siuntà from sių̃sti (“to send”), but note that the phonology of the Baltic word remains unclear; see Proto-Baltic *sjúnsti. * P
